statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring study, CPT 93229, is ordered
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The service is ordered to guide further management of complex cardiac rhythm disturbances
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197
